description.en: Drag documents into the dsh web chat for direct local-file processing; a right sidebar lists the outputs and file paths

harmonyos.notes: 零依赖纯 JS；拖拽文档进 Web 对话框直读本地文件处理，右侧侧栏展示产出与文件路径

description.en: HarmonyOS plugin market client: an independent settings section in dsh to browse and one-click install from this catalog

description.en: Push dsh task completion to HarmonyOS negative-one-screen (today-task / schedule)

harmonyos.notes: 零依赖纯 JS；配合鸿蒙负一屏推送通道（today-task / schedule 任务完成通知）

description.en: 'Global prompt-injection / context-virus defense for DeepSeek Harness: scans tool arguments, tool results, pre-model messages and the outbound stream; quarantine/block/monitor modes, canary trap, evolvable on-disk signature library with learn/import/export.'
description.zh: '全局提示注入 / 上下文病毒防御：扫描工具参数、工具结果、进模型前消息与出站流；隔离/阻断/监控三模式、金丝雀陷阱、可演进磁盘签名库（学习/导入/导出）。'

harmonyos.notes: 纯 JS 零原生依赖；全局提示注入/上下文病毒防御（扫描工具参数、结果、进模型前消息与出站流），三模式 + 金丝雀陷阱 + 可演进磁盘签名库（学习/导入/导出），审计落盘

harmonyos.notes: 纯 JS 零依赖；光遇·遇境主题皮肤，七大地图主题（遇境/晨岛/云野/雨林/霞谷/暮土/禁阁）设置页一键热切换
